ns2:section.sectionText: Prerequisite will be enforced. This section will open to Operations Management, Marketing, SBDE and SIE majors on Monday, November 14, 2022 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This section will open to all other Gies majors, Industrial & Enterprise Systems Engineering and Systems Engineering & Design students on Monday, November 21, 2022 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This section will open to all of campus to allow Business Minor and prospective Business Minor students the option to register for this elective not offered as an online option on Monday, November 28, 2022 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This is an elective course for undergraduate students pursuing the business minor.
